Subject: Orchid — next steps for MSA redline + Coupa onboarding

Connor — thanks for the quick intro earlier. We completed an internal review of Redwood's MSA and have a set of operational asks that will need to be resolved prior to Coupa provisioning. High level: 1) a handful of contract redlines (indemnity cap, DPA alignment), 2) PO acknowledgement window and invoice routing fields, and 3) proof of identity for the signer in our portal.

Can you loop in Legal and your Coupa ops lead so we can make a plan for a single round of redlines followed by a Coupa field mapping pass?

I've attached a consolidated list of portal fields we need mapped (we'll send the canonical export if that helps). Also including Tom from Coupa for scheduling.

Attachments: Orchid_portal_fields_v1.csv (referenced)
DocuSign link (signature-ready MSA will follow once redlines are agreed): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-12345

Thanks — Amelia

Subject: Re: Orchid — next steps for MSA redline + Coupa onboarding

Thanks — I reviewed the baseline and the portal field extract. High-level legal positions:

1) Indemnity & Cap: counterparty requested a broad indemnity; propose we offer a limited carve (IP infringement only) and keep cap at 3x fees. If Orchid pushes, we can offer a contractual audit-only right as a concession.

2) Data Processing / DPA: Orchid has some EU-traveling PO originators; we will require the standard DPA addendum. We can sign an addendum that mirrors our hosted data handling but cannot accept open-ended data retention requirements.

3) PO Acknowledgement window: 48 hours programmable in our routing policies is acceptable; 24 hours is operationally risky during high-load windows. Recommend 48 hours with fall-through routing to a billing queue.

4) Signatory proof: request for government ID is fine; prefer notarized corporate signatory as optional. We need to collect a sample portal proof artifact — Marissa, can Ops ingest the ID stamp into Coupa?

I'll return a tracked redline (MSA) by EOD Friday (8/6) that consolidates our positions. Please confirm if Orchid will accept a single consolidated redline (preferred) vs. line-item negotiation.

Attachments: Orchid_MSA_redline_v3.docx (will include tracked changes), Coupa_field_map_draft.xlsx (comments inline)

Subject: Operational playbook & tasking — Orchid Coupa activation

Amelia / Tom — thanks for the patience. Per Kimberly's comments, here's an operational playbook and task assignment for activation. Target: complete redline agreement and Coupa staging by end-of-day Thu 8/12.

Playbook (short):
- 8/6 (today): Kimberly posts final tracked MSA redline (action: Kimberly).
- 8/9: Redwood sends consolidated .docx to Orchid for acceptance/feedback (action: Connor).
- 8/10: Coupa mapping workshop (30m) — Tom to confirm slot; send test tenancy export prior to workshop (action: Tom).
- 8/11–8/12: Test staging and PO routing verification (action: Marissa/Onboarding team).
- 8/12 EOD: Sign-off on mapping and orderform addendum; proceed to DocuSign (action: Amelia).

Coupa-specific items for Tom:
- Map PO fields: buyer_id, remit_country, tax_jurisdiction, GL_code, three-tier line-level description. We flagged two fields as optional: invoice_comment and external_reference.
- PO ACK window: set to 48 hours with escalation to billing queue.

Orchid asks/decisions outstanding:
- Amelia: confirm acceptance of 48h PO ACK (explicit yes/no).
- Legal: confirm if DPA addendum template is acceptable or if Orchid will provide.

Attachments: Coupa_field_map_draft.xlsx, Orchid_Onboarding_ActionPlan_v1.pdf, orderform_addendum.xlsx

Connor — I'll schedule the workshop once Tom confirms availability. If Orchid needs a faster cadence, we can compress to a 3-business-day turnaround but that will move sign-off to EOD Mon 8/9.
